claims.assertion: Yazhi argues gravity creates matter and mass does not contain extractable energy, so nuclear chain-reaction detonations as described are impossible; conventional chemical blasts remain possible.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She suggests energy weapons may be misrepresented as nuclear; she says zero-point reactors can power ion-beam weapons.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She describes nuclear plants as radioactive and dangerous, but alleges they provide little grid electricity and mainly generate environmental frequencies; she says observers monitor them.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

review_flags: Yazhi distinguishes alleged energy weapons from radioactive materials and nuclear plants.
